children: SpaceX swings to a profit in its second-ever earnings report, boosted by a more-than-ninefold year-over-year increase in AI revenue to $7.6 billion. The company attributes this growth to cloud computing deals it activated during the third quarter, as well as the close of its acquisition of Cursor and increased adoption of Grok. SpaceX has found a lucrative line of business in selling data-center capacity to other AI companies such as Anthropic and Google, the latter of which agreed earlier this year to pay SpaceX $920 million a month beginning in October. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
